currentParagraphText: “No worries, no worries,” the beastkin shook his head as he pointed to a small stack of pamphlets on the desk in front of him. “Take one of those before you leave; it contains some basic etiquette rules and whatnot. It also helps with keeping track of endangered creatures you aren’t allowed to kill. It will also serve as the tracker for the map, and if need be, you can tear off the back page, and it should alert anyone else holding a pamphlet nearby.”
